services.name: Jet Skis
services.desc: Yamaha WaveRunner jet ski rentals in Miami from $145 an hour on Biscayne Bay. Star Island and downtown skyline route. Jet ski rentals in Miami at Funwaves start at $145 an hour. We launch from a marina on the Miami River and ride out into Biscayne Bay, looping past Star Island and the downtown Miami skyline. The fleet is Yamaha WaveRunners. Life jacket and fuel are included, and there's no upcharge at the dock. The bay is calm and protected, so it works for first-time riders too. This isn't just a rental, it's an unforgettable experience on Miami's stunning open water. With Yamaha WaveRunners, breathtaking coastline views, and the freedom to ride your way, every second delivers pure thrill.
